The '''Ixzinia system''' was located in the [[Agarix sector/Legends|Agarix sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="WesternReaches" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Ixzinian rock ram]]s.<ref name="Creatures" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ixzinia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-17.<ref name="TEA" />
